author: benhur
text:
Ranganus wrote: Compression should have a wider range and more wicks on both sides, to put out orders and trigger SL´s.

I am afraid this is a wrong definition for compression!

A compression is where price move (usually crawls) in one direction while it keep retrace back to consume the last of orders left. Please refer to the compressionarticle inmarkepediafro better understanding readthemarket.com/index.php/education/ma...9-compression-part-1
